learn.title: Learn the basics
learn.sip.b: A SIP means investing a fixed amount on a fixed date each month. It spreads your buying over time. Values still move up and down, so start from your goal and time frame.
learn.ef.b: It is money kept aside for sudden needs like job loss or medical bills, in a safe place you can reach fast. It stops you from selling investments in a hurry.
learn.drag.b: A regular plan has a distributor's commission built into its yearly cost. A direct plan does not. This example shows {corpus} over {years} years with the same assumed return.
learn.drag.diff: Difference: {diff}. An illustration, not a promise.
learn.reg.b: Only registered advisers can give investment advice. Always check the official registry. This box only demonstrates the idea with made-up names.
learn.reg.none: Not found in this sample list. In real life, check the official registry before trusting anyone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataBody: Demo data stays in this tab (sessionStorage) and disappears when you close it. After {minutes} minutes of no activity it is cleared. Nothing is sent to a database, and the server keeps no profile content or analytics. A real product would need consent, data minimisation, retention controls and a DPDP Act compliance review.
settings.remember: Remember my demo on this device
settings.rememberHint: Off by default. If on, it is kept for {hours} hours, then erased.
settings.langHint: The only choice that stays after you close the tab.
settings.aiLive: Live provider. Any answer that fails the number or safety checks is replaced by a safe fixture.
settings.aiFallback: A provider was chosen but its key or model is missing, so mock fixtures are used.
settings.constants: Figures marked TO_VERIFY are placeholders and must be checked before any real use.
assump.tagHint: {n} assumption(s) behind this have not been reviewed. Tap to see them.
assump.title: Assumptions behind the numbers
assump.sub: Every figure here is built on assumptions. Until a qualified adviser reviews an assumption it is marked unverified and shows a tag wherever it is used.
assump.english: The descriptions below are in English.
tradeoff.text: Your highest loan costs {loan} a year, and that cost is certain. In the assumed scenarios, long-term investing might return {low} to {high} a year after fees and before tax, which is not promised. How to balance repaying and investing is worth discussing with your reviewer.
adv.check.assumptions: I have reviewed the assumptions marked unverified for this plan.
check.found.none: No known warning signs were found in this check
check.uncertainty: This check uses fixed rules, so it can be wrong in both directions: it can miss a scam and it can flag a genuine message. Use it as a prompt to check, never as a decision.
check.couldNot.title: What this check could not do
check.couldNot.1: It did not look up any scam database.
check.couldNot.2: It did not open or visit any link.
check.couldNot.3: It could not verify who sent the message.
check.couldNot.4: It could not confirm any registration against a registry.
check.links.title: Link check (offline, from the address text only)
check.links.none: No known warning pattern in the address text. That does not mean the link is safe.
check.report.hint: Saves this message, with personal details hidden, to a review list on this device. Name removal is best-effort, so read the text above first.
check.report.done: Saved to the review list on this device. Thank you.
ai.how.mock: No AI model was used. This is wording written in advance, with your figures filled in by the app's own calculator. The demo is running without a model key.

ai.how.fixture: A live AI model was tried, but its answer failed a number or safety check, or was unavailable, so pre-written wording is shown instead. Nothing the model wrote is shown here.

act.health_gap: Ask your reviewer how much health cover would suit your family. The starting point to discuss is {needed}; you have {cover}.
act.high_cost_debt: List your loans by interest rate. One costs {rate}, above the {threshold} mark, so talk to your reviewer about which to pay down first.
act.dti_high: Your monthly loan payments take {dti} of your income. Write down which payments could come down or end soon.
act.savings_low: You save {rate} of your income. Pick a monthly amount to move toward {target}, and decide which spending could fund it.
act.concentration: Your largest sector is {share} of your investments. Note why you hold it and discuss with your reviewer whether to spread it.
act.overlap_high: Some of your holdings overlap by {overlap}. List what each one is for and discuss it with your reviewer.
act.tip_following: Write down the last tip you acted on and what happened. Bring it to your reviewer before acting on the next one.
act.irregular_income: Your income moves around. Note your lowest recent month and check that your reserve would cover it.
act.panic_sell: Your answers suggest a market fall could push you to act in a hurry. Write down your plan for a fall now, while you are calm, and share it with your reviewer.

ue.title: Unit economics (illustrative)
ue.banner: Illustrative. The numbers below are made-up defaults, not data and not a forecast. Change them.

ue.how: Cost per plan = expected review minutes / 60 x adviser cost per hour + AI cost. Cost per client = cost per plan x plans per year + other cost. Margin = price - cost. 220 working days a year.

dq.title: Before you rely on this: what is missing or looks off
dq.sub: These checks do not judge you. They say where a figure may be wrong because an answer is missing, a default was used, or answers do not fit together.
dq.issue.income_missing: Monthly income was not entered, so nothing that depends on it can be worked out.
dq.issue.essentials_missing: Essential monthly spending was not entered, so the reserve and the monthly picture cannot be worked out.
dq.issue.no_insurance: No insurance was entered. If you have cover, add it; the gaps shown assume none.
dq.issue.income_below_essentials: Your income is below your essential spending. Check both figures.
dq.issue.emi_above_income: Loan payments are more than your income. Check the loan payments and your income.
dq.issue.family_mismatch: Nobody depends on your income, but the family size is more than a single person. Check both.
dq.issue.goal_in_past: A goal has no time left. Check how many years it has.
dq.issue.round_values: Several amounts look like round placeholders (for example 1,00,000). Replace them with real figures if you can.
dq.issue.employer_unknown: Cover from your employer is unknown. If you have it, add it; the life-cover gap may be overstated.
dq.issue.defaults_used: Defaults are being used for: {fields}. Answer them to sharpen the numbers.
conf.label: Confidence: {level}
conf.why.implausible: An answer behind this looks off: {fields}.
conf.why.unverified: It rests on assumptions nobody has reviewed yet, so it is never shown as High.
conf.why.complete: Every answer behind this was entered.

check.verify.title: Before you do anything, verify
check.verify.1: Call the official number printed on your bank card or shown in your bank's own app. Do not use a number from this message.
check.verify.2: Do not use links from the message. Open the official app, or type the official website address yourself.
check.verify.3: Ask the sender for a registration you can check yourself on the official registry. Do not use a link they send.
check.verify.4: Do not pay, share an OTP or PIN, or install an app until you have verified.

ab.h1.pre: A product that shows its work, and
ab.lead: We help people understand their money and prepare for a conversation with a qualified person. We are built so that nobody, including us, can quietly turn a machine's draft into advice.
ab.does.title: What it does
ab.does.1: Calculates your position with fixed, visible formulas
ab.does.2: Prepares a draft plan, clearly marked as a draft
ab.does.3: Routes it to a person who edits and decides
ab.does.4: Records every change in a trail you can read
ab.does.5: Helps you check messages and learn the basics
ab.dont.title: What it does not do
ab.dont.1: Give stock tips, price targets or promised returns
ab.dont.2: Move money, buy or sell anything
ab.dont.3: Let AI approve its own work
ab.share.title: How humans and AI share the work
ab.share.4d: Edits, checks, approves, signs the record.
ab.for.title: Who it is for
ab.for.body: First-time investors, salaried people, small-business owners and families who want clarity before they talk to an adviser. Advisory firms that want preparation time back.
ab.pro.title: Role of registered professionals
ab.pro.body: Regulated advice must come from an appropriately registered person or firm. In this demo the adviser is a synthetic persona with no registration.
